User's hand is pulling the drawer outward; it is already substantially open.
Drawer is fully extended, exposing stored food and containers.
User grasps the extended drawer front to push it inward.
Drawer is fully closed and flush with the cabinet.

evidence.note: Both doors of the upper cabinet above the stove/range hood are closed.
User reaches to and begins pulling the left-hinged cabinet door.
Left cabinet door is open, revealing the cabinet interior.
Left and right cabinet doors remain open.
User is closing the left cabinet door while the right door remains open.
Cabinet doors are closed and aligned with the surrounding fronts.

events.object_description: Left door of the two-door upper cabinet above the stove/range hood

evidence.note: Left cabinet door is open, but the right door remains closed.
User manipulates the other cabinet leaf while the left leaf is already open.
Both cabinet doors are visibly open, exposing the full compartment.
Right cabinet door is still visibly open after the left leaf is being closed.
Right cabinet door is also closed; its closing action occurred within the short sampling interval.

events.object_description: Right door of the two-door upper cabinet above the stove/range hood

evidence.note: Wide top drawer in the base cabinet to the right of the stove is closed.
User grasps the drawer handle to initiate opening.
Drawer is substantially open, exposing foil boxes, cloths, and utensils.
Drawer remains fully extended.
User pushes the drawer shut; the front is nearly or fully flush.
Drawer is fully closed.

events.object_description: Wide upper drawer in the base cabinet immediately right of the stove

notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The two leaves of the upper cabinet are reported separately because they are manipulated sequentially. Their closing transitions occur very close together between the sparsely sampled frames, so the right-door off time is less certain.
scene_description: A user surveys a narrow modern kitchen, then opens and closes a food-storage drawer left of the stove, separately opens and closes both doors of the upper cabinet above the stove, and finally opens and closes a utensil/foil drawer right of the stove.
